snippet.title: NightmareScape Trailer (Yume Nikki Fangame)
snippet.description:
Nightmarescape is a Yume Nikki Fangame im working on where you play as a 12 year old blue-haired girl named Akari. She refuses to leave her bedroom, but she goes to sleep and experiences her very weird dreams... I Really hope everyone likes it when it comes out!
Inspiration: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4C9lkrDGcw0
